hero.headline: Fly the network. Keep the logbook.
hero.body: A regional fleet, a published schedule, and a crew room that spans a dozen countries. Pick a route, fly it in your simulator, and file the report when you land.
hero.footnote: Free to join. Any simulator. Any experience level.

sections.title: A virtual airline, run by the people who fly it
sections.body: We are a group of flight simulator pilots flying a shared route network on a shared schedule. No subscriptions, no minimum hours, no gatekeeping — just a dispatch board, a fleet, and people who like flying the same aeroplanes you do.
